messages:
marco: planning a tiny recognition experiment called ShelfSurprise. want to do a one-week nomination window and desk/ship drops. need owners for vendor, pack day, volunteer notes, and comms. target ship date 2024-05-10.

anya: I can take vendor and pickup. need qty estimate by 5/03 and final art by 5/01.

priya: i'll do comms (Slack + email) and draft a 30-second nomination form. want anonymous option.

sam: happy to coordinate volunteers for handwritten notes and run a sign-up sheet.

marco: budget ceiling $7/kit + shipping. finance ok with customs handling for kits >$50.

ops-bot: Inventory snapshot: pins=90, postcards=250, gift-cards=30.

anya: vendor quoted 8 business days lead time. can do enamel pin + sticker combo. uploading quote to drive.

priya: draft announcement below, open to edits:
```
Hey team — ShelfSurprise pilot is live. Nominate a teammate in one sentence. Winners get a small desk token + handwritten note. Noms close 5/06. Form: <link>
```

marco: add line: winners will be contacted before public shoutouts. also add opt-out for recipients.

sam: sign-up created: <signup-link>. scheduling two pack sessions on 5/08 and 5/09.

anya: please confirm final headcount by 5/03. vendor needs art + qty by 5/01 to hit ship date.

priya: will post announcement on 5/07 at 10am PT.

ops-bot: Reminder set: collect headcount on 2024-05-03 09:00 UTC.
